verdict.rationale: Notte publishes its own API reference section in its docs, with endpoint pages such as authentication (Bearer token) and agent-start, so a reference does exist. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive playground, runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
